title: Towards unsupervised representation learning for quantum data: quantum models with inference and generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.00372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With quantum sensors, simulators and networks emerging, a future of quantum technology may produce quantum states as data---that is, coherently rather than as classical measurement records---thus motivating the study of suitable quantum generalisations of modern machine learning, including the automated, unsupervised extraction of useful representations. Two ingredients are central to the latter: inference, mapping observations to latent representations, and generation, mapping latent states back to synthetic data. Both are related to each other and to joint distributions for training models by the chain-rule of classical probability theory. The fact that quantum states however lack such universal, standard factorisation property thus poses a challenge. Here we develop a conceptual and mathematical framework for unsupervised representation learning from quantum data. Models are joint quantum states over visible and latent systems; stat

translated_title: 面向量子数据的无监督表征学习：具备推理与生成能力的量子模型
translated_abstract: 随着量子传感器、量子模拟器和量子网络的兴起，未来量子技术可能将量子态本身作为数据产生——即以相干方式而非经典测量记录的方式——这促使人们研究现代机器学习在量子领域的适当推广，包括自动化、无监督地提取有用的表征。其中有两个核心要素：推理，即将观测映射到潜在表征；以及生成，即将潜在态映射回合成数据。在经典概率论中，这两者通过链式法则相互关联，并与用于训练模型的联合分布相联系。然而，量子态缺乏这种普适的、标准的分解性质，因此构成了一个挑战。本文为从量子数据中进行无监督表征学习开发了一个概念性与数学性的框架。模型被定义为覆盖可见系统与潜在系统的联合量子态；……
tldr: 本文针对量子态缺乏经典概率链式法则分解性质这一挑战，提出了从量子数据中进行无监督表征学习的概念与数学框架，以可见系统与潜在系统的联合量子态为模型，建立了量子版的推理与生成机制。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a conceptual and mathematical framework for unsupervised representation learning from quantum data, using joint quantum states over visible and latent systems to define quantum analogues of inference and generation, thereby addressing the challenge that quantum states lack a classical chain-rule factorization property.
